name: FloatingCombatTextSpawner
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play "floating combat text" — damage/heal/miss/status numbers that pop up over a world-space hit point, drift, and fade (the classic RPG/action-game hit-feedback). A Singleton, same pattern as Toolkit.Tweening.FadeManager/ShaderTransitionManager: call FloatingCombatTextSpawner.Instance. SpawnDamage(...) from ANYWHERE (a Health/Combat script) with no manual Canvas wiring — it builds its own overlay canvas + pool the first time it's used.  `presets` IS the style dropdown: each entry is tagged with a CombatTextStyle and is fully editable right in the Inspector (color, size, motion, duration, drift) — add your own entries for new categories rather than editing code. Pooled via the existing Toolkit.Core.ObjectPool, same reuse trick as FlyToUIEffect.  Deliberately a ONE-SHOT screen-space conversion at spawn time, not continuous world tracking — correct for this tool's short (roughly 1 second) lifetime, and much simpler. If you need text that keeps following a moving target for longer than that, use Toolkit.UI.WorldSpaceUIFollow instead.

src_serialized.name: textPrefab
src_serialized.tooltip: Optional custom prefab (needs a TMP_Text + FloatingCombatText component). Leave empty to auto-build a plain default at runtime.

src_serialized.name: worldCamera
src_serialized.tooltip: Camera used to convert the world hit point to screen space. Defaults to Camera.main if left empty.

src_serialized.name: spawnJitterRadius
src_serialized.tooltip: Random screen-space scatter so several simultaneous hits don't perfectly overlap.

src_serialized.name: presets
src_serialized.tooltip: The style presets Spawn()/SpawnDamage()/SpawnHeal()/SpawnMiss()/SpawnStatus() look up by CombatTextStyle. Edit freely, or add new CombatTextStyle values with their own entries.
